about_the_game:
Welcome to Your Playground in the Sky.

Drone District is the entry-level game in the line-up of available FPV drone titles. If you're looking to jump right into the action and fulfill your drone-flying fantasy in an Arcade-focused game without a steep learning curve - we've got what you need. The game mashes up the flow of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater with the freedom of Burnout Paradise—but with drones. And bullet-time.

DRONE DISTRICT OFFERS:

🌀 Arcade-Style Flight, Real Physics
Fluid controls let you boost, drift, and snap-turn like a pro—while physics-driven movement rewards precision and style. The flight model is realistic, but the controls are designed for an exciting and fast-paced arcade experience.

🎯 Trick Combos & Style System
Slides, grinds, flips, barrel rolls—chain tricks together for insane score multipliers to unlock achievements and make your way up to the top of the leaderboard.

🌆 Open-World Playground
Dash through tight alleys, coast over rooftops, or skim the beachfront at golden hour. Every corner of the city is a stunt opportunity. Perform special challenges to unlock hidden areas!

🎮FPV Controller support

The game is playable on a keyboard, but - as you would expect - it's preferrable to use an Xbox controller... but if you happen to own an actual FPV set controller, there's a good chance the game already supports it. You'll be able to re-map the particular controls to your liking in-game.

🏁 Time Trials, Trick Zones, Collectibles & More
Take on high-score challenges, speedrun races, and hidden collectibles scattered across the district.

🛹Our Vision: an Entry-Level Game for FPV Drone Pilots
Flying FPV drones in real life may not be an easy passion to pick up. But neither was skateboarding. Yet, a game like Tony Hawks Pro Skater came out and gave thousands of people an impulse to jump on a real-life skateboard. We want Drone District to be that game for future FPV pilots!

Whether you're a freestyle pilot or a score-chasing maniac, Drone District delivers fast, fun, and stylish flight in a city that never stops moving. Wishlist now!
